description: How a data home's touchline-data.yaml states its NCAA level. One set of vectors for every marker reader: pipeline/src/paths.py marker_level and home_level (tests/test_paths.py), src/datahome.ts markerLevel and readMarker, and bin/resolve-membership.ts home-level, which the cadence and the workflow guards call (test/datahome.test.ts). 'absent' takes the legacy d2 default and says it assumed it; 'invalid' refuses the marker; anything else is the declared level.

vectors.name: a longer key is not the level key
plain d2 without a final newline
an inline comment
vectors.text:
kind: touchline-data
version: 1
level: d1 # Division I

vectors.name: an inline comment after a tab
vectors.text:
kind: touchline-data
version: 1
level: d2	# Division II

vectors.name: the d1 home's marker as written
vectors.text:
# Marker file: identifies this directory as a Touchline data home.
# The touchline rib validates this file before running workflows here.
kind: touchline-data
version: 1
# The NCAA level this home holds. A collect of a conference at another level is refused.
level: d1

vectors.name: an unknown level with an extra word
vectors.text:
kind: touchline-data
version: 1
level: d4 extra

vectors.name: a valid level with an extra word
vectors.text:
kind: touchline-data
version: 1
level: d1 extra

vectors.name: a value that is only a comment
a hash inside the value is not a comment
the key stated twice
vectors.text:
kind: touchline-data
version: 1
level: d1
level: d2
